Cloud 9 defines ephemeralization as higher ordered complexity at lower cost.
The thermodynamic ledger is supposed to make η visible.
These two are not yet connected in a living loop.

Needed: A minimal path that lets a Cloud 9 observation write a measurable η entry (or receive one).
